datasets.creator: Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software
datasets.statement: Copyright 2010 by the Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software.
datasets.modifications: The text is taken from the MACULA Greek syntax trees and stored as one file per chapter, with each word kept separately alongside the punctuation and space that follow it (elision marks are stored with that punctuation). The wording is not changed.

datasets.name: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets
datasets.creator: Clear Bible
datasets.statement: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-greek/
datasets.modifications: Converted from the SBLGNT lowfat XML to JSON. Only each word's text, following punctuation, verse, lemma, gloss, part of speech and morphology are kept; Louw-Nida and UBS semantic-domain data and the syntax trees are removed.
